verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the CLI. It deploys event sources from local or remote code, and `pd dev` links a local file to the deployed component. That lets users keep source code in their own version control and redeploy earlier versions as a workaround. Nothing documents built-in version history, change review, or rollback for workflows themselves. Missing for 10: native workflow version history, diff/review of changes, one-click rollback, git sync for workflows (not just sources), independent corroboration.
